title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Professor de francês
description:

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Analista de Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.
  • Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.
  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.

No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre.


About Fullinfo

Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform.

The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.


The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense.


The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say.


Role description

As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform.

This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable.

You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly.


Your work includes:

• Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda

• Building services across the data pipeline

• Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services

• Improving performance and cost efficiency

• Keeping the architecture clean and understandable

• Writing code that is easy to read, test and change

• Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular

• Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows


Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts.


Requirements

You bring:

• 5 plus years of backend engineering experience

• Strong TypeScript experience

• Real experience with AWS serverless services

• Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS

• A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability

• Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process

• Business level English

• You are based within 3 hours of Central European Time or are located in LATAM


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work

• Long term project with unlimited extensions


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.

Apply trough the link.

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.

  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as

  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: AI Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM


About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across a diverse range of genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As an AI Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of voice design and performance across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and expertise in AI Voice design Tools.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Voice Evaluation & Platform Coordination

Evaluate and benchmark AI-generated voices across platforms, maintaining a curated repository of approved voices. Continuously assess new features, tools, and model updates to enhance voice quality. Partner with product and AI voice platform teams to optimize voice solutions (including language-specific improvements).

2. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Work with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, forecast deliverables, and ensure timely execution of projects. Maintain visibility on production timelines and proactively address bottlenecks.

3. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

4. AI-driven Innovations and tool adoption

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.

5. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Editorial, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to ensure alignment on production goals, timelines, and quality standards. Share learnings and best practices across teams and geographies.

6. Production Quality Oversight

Partner with the QC team to review and approve episodes, ensuring adherence to quality benchmarks and creative intent. Identify and resolve issues related to voice quality, narration, sound design, and technical consistency prior to release.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring & Optimization

Monitor listener feedback, user comments, and performance metrics to identify areas of improvement in content quality and engagement. Collaborate with relevant teams to implement enhancements and optimize the overall listening experience.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously improve production workflows, creator management practices, and operational efficiency. Document processes, guidelines, and best practices to enable consistent and scalable content production.

9. Deliverables & Performance Expectations

Ensure timely delivery of all assigned episodes in line with targets. Drive structured coordination across stakeholders, resulting in high-quality, QC-approved audio content. Contribute to process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-team collaboration.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, voice design, post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with Pro Tools, Elevenlabs, and similar platforms.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack Lead Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Lead Developer to join our growing engineering team. This role combines hands-on senior development with day-to-day team leadership, working closely with the CTO. You will design and build software while also manage day-to-day engineering operations - including ticket creation and assignment, PR oversight, and team processes.


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is technically strong and has prior experience in a lead role - someone who enjoys writing production code, mentoring a talented senior team, and helping coordinate the day-to-day workflow so the CTO can focus on higher-level direction.


You will work across application code and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with the CTO to deliver scalable, reliable systems and keep a high-performing team running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Engineering Operations

• Work closely with the CTO to manage day-to-day engineering workload and ensure the team stays productive and unblocked

• Own ticket creation, triage, and assignment, keeping the backlog healthy and priorities clear

• Oversee pull request processes, ensuring code quality standards are upheld and reviews are timely

• Maintain and improve engineering processes and standards across a predominantly senior team

• Ensure strong database practices are followed across the team, including schema design, query efficiency, and data integrity

• Serve as a technical point of contact for escalations, cross-team coordination, and architectural decisions


Software Development & Feature Delivery

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET

• Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability

• Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems

• Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack

• Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers


Azure Cloud & DevOps

• Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure, with a focus on reliability and observability

• Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps

• Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution

• Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost


Required Qualifications


Experience & Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

• 7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development

• Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency)


Technical Skills (Priority Order)

• Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework

• Proven experience in a lead or senior lead developer role, assisting engineering management with day-to-day team operations

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL knowledge from a developer perspective
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs

• Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Storage, and Azure SQL Database

• Experience integrating with third-party APIs

• CRM system experience and familiarity with common CRM integration patterns

• Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies

• Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps


Soft Skills

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability

• Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams


Bonus Qualifications

• Experience with communications platforms and APIs such as Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, or similar for SMS, voice, and messaging workflows

• Familiarity with real-time communications protocols: VoIP, WebRTC, and SIP

• Experience with open-source telephony platforms such as Asterisk or FreeSWITCH

• Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)

• Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations

• Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments


What We Offer

• Competitive salary commensurate with experience

• Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions

• A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para SDET Coordinator - Disaster Recovery em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients that is a leading healthcare company in the United States, focused on technology, operational resilience, and large-scale enterprise


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate disaster recovery (DR) testing activities across enterprise applications and services
  • Develop and execute structured DR test scenarios aligned with predefined recovery patterns
  • Produce detailed post-test reports, including outcomes, gaps, and recommendations for improvement
  • Track the build-out process of applications and services adhering to established DR strategies
  • Capture and manage corrective action plan (CAP) items in tools such as Fusion or ServiceNow
  • Support the adoption of automated and continuous testing practices for production systems
  • Maintain and manage scheduled (cadenced) DR testing cycles to ensure ongoing readiness
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on testing efficiency and DR process enhancements
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional DR team members and stakeholders
  • Facilitate coordination and execution of DR exercises to reduce risk and improve resilience
  • Support additional DR-related activities and initiatives as assigned by leadership


Required Qualifications

  • Experience in Disaster Recovery, IT resilience, or testing and validation processes
  • Strong understanding of disaster recovery concepts such as RTO, RPO, failover, and service restoration
  • Experience coordinating and executing testing activities in enterprise IT environments
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow for tracking incidents and action items
  • Ability to analyze test results and produce clear, actionable reports
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple testing cycles and priorities
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with effective collaboration skills
  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)
  • Problem-solving mindset with focus on risk reduction and process improvement


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• International team environment

  • Projetar e evoluir a arquitetura AWS Serverless DataLake, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e suporte a múltiplos workflows de dados.

  • Kubernetes & Terraform

  • Data Engineering Pipelines
  • CI/CD & Observability

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS B2B/B2B2C
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Investimentos WS B2B/B2B2C em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empreenda como Consultor Independente com a Revert - B2B/B2B2C


Você buscou ser livre.

Mas a operação te prendeu de novo.

Relatório pra um cliente.

Conciliação de outro.

Extrato que não bate.

E-mail cobrando posição.


No fim, você virou consultor pra passar mais tempo com cliente…

e está passando mais tempo com planilha.


O que é a Revert


A Revert é uma empresa de tecnologia baseada em serviços, criando um ecossistema de consultorias de investimentos independente, construída para tirar o peso da operação do consultor.


Aqui, a lógica é simples:

enquanto você está com o cliente, a operação roda por trás.

  • Consolidação de carteira automática
  • Suporte operacional completo
  • Uso de tecnologia e IA para ganho de escala
  • Atendimento em múltiplas instituições (sem ficar preso a uma plataforma)
  • Acesso a TODOS os bancos.


Não é software.

É o serviço funcionando por você.


Para quem é

Essa oportunidade é para quem:

  • Já tem carteira de clientes no mundo consultoria
  • Quer parar de perder tempo com operacional
  • Busca mais tempo de qualidade com o cliente
  • Quer escalar sua atuação como consultor independente

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

description:

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

title: Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professional Services Developer - Remote Position (Brazil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Professional Services Developer

Department: Professional Services

Reports To: Head of Professional Services

Location: Magentrix Corporation

Status: Full-Time


Role Summary

The Professional Services Developer is a hybrid technical-consultant responsible for the successful implementation and customization of the Magentrix platform. Unlike traditional product development, this role focuses on translating unique client business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable technical solutions. You are not just writing code; you are a trusted advisor helping customers maximize the value of the platform through expert configuration, custom development, and seamless integrations.


Key Responsibilities

Technical Implementation & Solution Architecture

  • Expert Implementation: Lead the technical delivery of the Magentrix platform, ensuring it is configured and customized to meet specific client business processes.
  • Consultative Development: Act as a bridge between technical possibilities and business needs, helping customers \"bridge the gap\" through tailored code and configurations.
  • Customization & Extension: Build elegant, secure web-based business solutions using Magentrix APIs, ensuring all extensions are maintainable and high-performing.
  • Integration Excellence: Design and implement secure API integrations between Magentrix and third-party systems (CRMs, ERPs, etc.), ensuring data integrity and security.

Client Engagement & Collaboration

  • Requirement Gathering: Participate in discovery sessions to understand customer pain points and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Fast-Paced Delivery: Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, balancing speed of delivery with the high-quality standards expected in Professional Services.
  • Quality Assurance: Perform unit tests and participate in code reviews with a focus on both security vulnerabilities and user experience (UX) .
  • Incident Management: Promptly troubleshoot and resolve client-reported issues, providing clear communication on root causes and resolutions.

Security & Compliance

  • Follow secure coding best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure all client-specific customizations comply with organizational security policies.
  • Collaborate with security teams to address potential risks and implement mitigation controls.


Skills & Qualifications

Technical Proficiency

  • Full-Stack Development: Proficient with JavaScript, Vue.js, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3 , and the Tailwind framework.
  • Backend Mastery: Strong experience with C#.NET, MVC, SQL databases , and ORM frameworks (e.g., Entity Framework).
  • Architectural Knowledge: Solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and RDBMS databases.


Professional & Consultative Skills

  • 7+ Years Experience: Minimum 7+ years in software development, with a preference for client-facing or agency environments .
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to look at a product and determine the most efficient way to customize it without compromising future upgrades.
  • Communication: Exceptional oral and written communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Agile Adaptability: Experience working in Agile environments where requirements may shift based on client feedback.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

﻿

Why This Role is Unique

\"As a Professional Services Developer, you aren't just building a product; you are building a solution. You have the unique opportunity to see the immediate impact of your work on a client's business operations, making you a vital part of the customer's success story.\"

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor de Investimentos WS B2B/B2B2C em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empreenda como Consultor Independente com a Revert - B2B/B2B2C


Você buscou ser livre.

Mas a operação te prendeu de novo.

Relatório pra um cliente.

Conciliação de outro.

Extrato que não bate.

E-mail cobrando posição.


No fim, você virou consultor pra passar mais tempo com cliente…

e está passando mais tempo com planilha.


O que é a Revert


A Revert é uma empresa de tecnologia baseada em serviços, criando um ecossistema de consultorias de investimentos independente, construída para tirar o peso da operação do consultor.


Aqui, a lógica é simples:

enquanto você está com o cliente, a operação roda por trás.

  • Consolidação de carteira automática
  • Suporte operacional completo
  • Uso de tecnologia e IA para ganho de escala
  • Atendimento em múltiplas instituições (sem ficar preso a uma plataforma)
  • Acesso a TODOS os bancos.


Não é software.

É o serviço funcionando por você.


Para quem é

Essa oportunidade é para quem:

  • Já tem carteira de clientes no mundo consultoria
  • Quer parar de perder tempo com operacional
  • Busca mais tempo de qualidade com o cliente
  • Quer escalar sua atuação como consultor independente


⚠️ Importante

Estamos no início e sendo seletivos com nossos parceitos.

Fazemos poucas parcerias — com quem realmente quer construir algo grande.


Interessou?

  • Se fez sentido, vamos conversar.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA + Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

  • Cost and capacity management in Azure 
  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  
  • Prior team lead experience

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Regional Study Director, LATAM
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Regional Study Director, LATAM em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world’s premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others.


Position Summary:

Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.


Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:

These may include but are not limited to:

  • Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM.
  • Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM.
  • May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM.
  • Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc.
  • Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs.
  • Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation.
  • Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives.
  • Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities.
  • Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors.
  • Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms.
  • Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate.
  • Outline regional activation hurdles for team.
  • Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities.
  • Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed.
  • Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed.
  • Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations.
  • Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed.
  • Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results.
  • Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals.
  • Make timely, data-driven decisions.
  • Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered.
  • 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role.
  • Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements.
  • Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems.
  • Excellent understanding of drug development process.
  • Experience in clinical trial supply management.
  • Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution.

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Retention Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?


About you:

This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you’ll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.


What You’ll Own:

  • Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue.
  • You’ll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI.
  • Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines.
  • Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved.
  • Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value.
  • Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured “silent churn” playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces.
  • Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

description:

Company Description

Gravity Interactive, Inc., established in California in 2003, is a leader in the online gaming industry, providing Gravity games to gamers across North America and beyond. It is the wholly owned subsidiary of Gravity Co., Ltd., a company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Gravity Co., Ltd. is globally renowned for developing the popular MMORPG title, Ragnarok Online, which has captivated players worldwide. With a mission to deliver exceptional gaming experiences, Gravity Interactive continues to serve a diverse and international audience.
